new_scholarship.name: CAS-ANSO Scholarship (Degree Program) 2026
new_scholarship.official_source: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences (UCAS)
new_scholarship.description: The CAS-ANSO Scholarship (Degree Program), previously the ANSO Scholarship for Young Talents, is the postgraduate scholarship of the Alliance of National and International Science Organizations for the Belt and Road Regions (ANSO), sponsored by the Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS) and administered at the University of Chinese Academy of Sciences (UCAS) for master's and PhD study. The 2026 call opened for application on 15 October 2025 and closed for applicants and referees on 31 January 2026 Beijing Time; results were announced in June 2026 and the 2027 call was not yet published on 2026-10-04. The 2026 coverage table published on the call page lists tuition waiver, a monthly stipend of CNY 6,000 or 7,000 for PhD candidates and CNY 3,000 for master's candidates, health insurance, application fee waiver, one international travel allowance and a one-time visa/residence permit allowance. A sub-category, the ANSO-CAS-TWAS/UNESCO PhD Scholarship, selects up to 40 PhD students from developing countries each year, with 10 scholarships prioritised for recipients engaged in climate-related research.
new_scholarship.duration: PhD: monthly stipend for up to 48 months. Master's: monthly stipend for up to 36 months. The official page states the scholarship duration explicitly in the Admission Notice.
new_scholarship.deadline: Deadline for Applicants and Referees: 31st January 2026 (Beijing Time) for the 2026 cycle, which has now closed. The 2027 call was not published on the UCAS site on 2026-10-04.
new_scholarship.application_period: 15 October 2025 to 31 January 2026 (Beijing Time) for the 2026 cycle. The 2027 window was not published on 2026-10-04.
new_scholarship.eligibility_summary: Applicants must not hold Chinese citizenship, must hold a valid foreign passport, must be proficient in English or Chinese, and must meet the UCAS admission criteria for international students. Master's applicants must be born after 1 January 1996 (inclusive) and PhD applicants after 1 January 1991 (inclusive). Applicants currently pursuing a master's or doctoral degree at any institution in China are barred from the corresponding level of this scholarship, and applying through both USTC and UCAS simultaneously leads to disqualification.

programme_detail_official.description: The CAS-ANSO Scholarship (Degree Program), launched in 2019 as the ANSO Scholarship for Young Talents, trains young scientists from all over the world through postgraduate study. CAS is the major sponsor; the degree program supports 100 to 200 master's students and 300 PhD students every year at USTC, UCAS and CAS institutes. UCAS is responsible for the enrolment and management of the master's and doctoral candidates it admits. The 2026 coverage table published by UCAS itemises tuition waiver, a degree-level-dependent monthly stipend, health insurance, application fee waiver, one international travel allowance and a one-time visa/residence permit allowance.

new_scholarship.program_type: Government scholarship administered by the China Scholarship Council, Type B (university nomination), awarded through Peking University
new_scholarship.description: The Chinese Government Scholarship for Advanced Graduate Program is a merit-based award from the China Scholarship Council for international students with outstanding academic backgrounds, awarded through Peking University under Type B. Peking University's 2026 notice states the scope as 'Full or partial tuition waiver, living stipend, housing, and medical insurance' for a duration of 2 to 3 years at master's level and 4 to 5 years at doctoral level. Applicants must first secure admission to a self-funded full-time international graduate programme and then apply twice: once in the Peking University International Student Service System and once in the China Scholarship Council system. The 2026 cycle closed at 9:00 a.m. Beijing Time on 9 March 2026 for the PKU form and 24:00 Beijing Time on 17 March 2026 for the CSC form, and the 2027 notice had not been published on 2026-10-04.
new_scholarship.duration: Master's degree: 2 - 3 years. Doctoral degree: 4 - 5 years. Renewable on an annual basis provided the holder passes the annual scholarship review.
new_scholarship.deadline: For the 2026 cycle the Peking University online scholarship application was 'open now until Beijing Time at 9:00 a.m. on March 9' and the China Scholarship Council application 'open now until Beijing Time at 24:00 on March 17'. Both dates have passed; the 2027 notice was not published on 2026-10-04.
new_scholarship.application_period: The standing programme page states 'Application Time: Generally in January and March each year'. The 2026 cycle ran from the notice date of 12 January 2026 to 9 March 2026 (PKU) and 17 March 2026 (CSC).
new_scholarship.eligibility_summary: Applicants must meet the admission requirements for international students of Peking University, must have successfully submitted an application for the current year's full-time self-funded graduate programme as an international student, must not have received any other scholarship from the Chinese government or Peking University (except one-time non-renewable merit awards), and must not be a candidate in a joint training programme.

Is not a candidate in a joint training programme

alerts.message: The 2026 cycle closed at 09:00 Beijing Time on 9 March for the PKU form and 24:00 Beijing Time on 17 March for the CSC form. Both have passed as of 2026-10-04.
The latest scholarship notice on isd.pku.edu.cn is the 2026 cycle. Peking University has published this notice in January in prior years, so monitor the site from January.
Do not treat the CSC deadline as the only one. The PKU internal scholarship application closes roughly a week earlier.
The CSC system permits only one major per applicant, and the award is evaluated on that major. Coordinate your PKU and CSC major selection.

submission_workflow: Obtain and confirm admission to a full-time self-funded international graduate programme at Peking University
Read the January scholarship notice on isd.pku.edu.cn and the attached instructions for the Chinese Government Scholarship Information System
Log on to the Peking University International Student Service System and submit one scholarship application for all applicable categories
Upload official transcripts and supporting documents in the PKU system
Download the Certificate for CSC Advanced Graduate Program Application from the PKU system's Application Status page when it becomes available
Submit the PKU application before its 09:00 Beijing Time deadline
Log on to the China Scholarship Council system, complete and submit the Type B application under institution code 10001, and save the completed form
Submit the CSC application before its 24:00 Beijing Time deadline
Await the Peking University Admission Letter rather than relying on CSC system status
